name: debrid
author: silasmariusz
title: Debrid & premium hosts
description: Hoster links and cached magnets become direct downloads through your debrid, multihoster or premium accounts.

settings.name: order
settings.title: Provider order
settings.description: Provider ids, separated by commas. The extension asks the enabled providers in this order for each link. The ids: torbox, alldebrid, premiumize, realdebrid, debridlink, rapideo, nopremium, twojlimit, onefichier, rapidgator, nitroflare.

settings.name: magnets_via_debrid
settings.title: Magnets through debrid when cached
settings.description: Ask the enabled debrid services for a magnet's files when they already have the torrent cached. Off: magnets never go to them.

settings.name: torbox_enabled
settings.title: Use TorBox
settings.description: Hoster links and cached magnets go through your TorBox account.

settings.name: torbox_apikey
settings.title: TorBox API key
settings.description: The API key from your TorBox account settings.

settings.name: alldebrid_enabled
settings.title: Use AllDebrid
settings.description: Hoster links and cached magnets go through your AllDebrid account.

settings.name: alldebrid_apikey
settings.title: AllDebrid API key
settings.description: An API key from your AllDebrid account.

settings.name: premiumize_enabled
settings.title: Use Premiumize
settings.description: Hoster links and cached magnets go through your Premiumize account.

settings.name: premiumize_apikey
settings.title: Premiumize API key
settings.description: The API key from your Premiumize account page.

settings.name: realdebrid_enabled
settings.title: Use Real-Debrid
settings.description: Hoster links and cached magnets go through your Real-Debrid account.

settings.name: realdebrid_token
settings.title: Real-Debrid private API token
settings.description: The private API token from your Real-Debrid account.

settings.name: debridlink_enabled
settings.title: Use Debrid-Link
settings.description: Hoster links and cached magnets go through your Debrid-Link account.

settings.name: debridlink_apikey
settings.title: Debrid-Link API key
settings.description: The API key from your Debrid-Link account.

settings.name: rapideo_enabled
settings.title: Use Rapideo
settings.description: Hoster links go through your Rapideo account.

settings.name: rapideo_login
settings.title: Rapideo login
settings.description: The login of your Rapideo account.

settings.name: rapideo_password
settings.title: Rapideo password
settings.description: The password of your Rapideo account.

settings.name: nopremium_enabled
settings.title: Use NoPremium
settings.description: Hoster links go through your NoPremium account.

settings.name: nopremium_login
settings.title: NoPremium login
settings.description: The login of your NoPremium account.

settings.name: nopremium_password
settings.title: NoPremium password
settings.description: The password of your NoPremium account.

settings.name: twojlimit_enabled
settings.title: Use Twojlimit
settings.description: Hoster links go through your Twojlimit account.

settings.name: twojlimit_login
settings.title: Twojlimit login
settings.description: The login of your Twojlimit account.

settings.name: twojlimit_password
settings.title: Twojlimit password
settings.description: The password of your Twojlimit account.

settings.name: onefichier_enabled
settings.title: Use 1fichier
settings.description: 1fichier links download with your 1fichier premium account.

settings.name: onefichier_apikey
settings.title: 1fichier API key
settings.description: The API key from your 1fichier premium account.

settings.name: rapidgator_enabled
settings.title: Use Rapidgator
settings.description: Rapidgator links download with your Rapidgator premium account.

settings.name: rapidgator_login
settings.title: Rapidgator login
settings.description: The email address you log in to Rapidgator with.

settings.name: rapidgator_password
settings.title: Rapidgator password
settings.description: The password of your Rapidgator account.

settings.name: rapidgator_2fa_secret
settings.title: Rapidgator 2FA secret
settings.description: optional: the base32 secret of your Rapidgator two-factor app

settings.name: nitroflare_enabled
settings.title: Use Nitroflare
settings.description: Nitroflare links download with your Nitroflare premium account.

settings.name: nitroflare_user
settings.title: Nitroflare user
settings.description: The email address of your Nitroflare account.

settings.name: nitroflare_premium_key
settings.title: Nitroflare premium key
settings.description: The premium key of your Nitroflare account.

settings.name: advanced_api_base
settings.title: Advanced: API base URL
settings.description: For testing only: send every provider's requests to this base URL.
